blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The trough of a tropical depression will continue to affect Visayas and Mindanao, while localized thunderstorms may prevail over the rest of the country on Thursday, Sept. 24. This is the forecast from Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) at 5 p.m. today (Wednesday). The weather bureau reported that the extension of the tropical depression will still bring gloomy skies tomorrow, with scattered rains and thunderstorms over Eastern Visayas, Caraga, Davao Region and Sarangani.
